summary: Antares Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K reporting entry into amended and restated investment advisory and administration agreements with its adviser, Antares Capital Credit Advisers LLC, in response to state securities regulator comments on its continuous offering. The terms are unchanged except for indemnification and expense clarifications. The filing also notes an amendment to articles of incorporation, but no specifics are provided. These are routine contractual updates with no special-situation event like a merger, tender, or restructuring.
